summary: Rocket One Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Major General Malcolm Frost (Ret.) to its Advisory Board. The filing contains no deal terms, stakes, or prices; it is a routine advisory-board appointment. The company issued a press release describing Frost's role guiding technical development for AI and defense infrastructure. There is no acquisition, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The event is a standard governance or advisory disclosure without special-situation characteristics.
